summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Times Tables iteration 2. Verified theme toggle (light/dark persists), sound toggle (persists), 1-20 range selector with all 5 presets (easy/core/twelve/all/tough), op-mode chips (mul/div/mixed), Quick-Fire questions honor opMode (× vs ÷), Learn page (picker 1-20, full table 1×n..12×n, tips for each table including 13-20, Drill mode with hint on wrong answer), Daily Challenge (30 questions seeded by today, progress HUD, completion writes state.daily and shows completed view on revisit), Stats empty-state for tables with no data, full nav (nav-home/learn/daily/stats/shop) and mobile m-nav-* exist, localStorage v2 key persistence across reload. Daily questions are deterministic per day-seed and have no consecutive duplicates (first 5 today: 12×3, 18÷9, 6×3, 90÷10, 10×2). No console errors observed during sound effect playback.
critical_code_review_comments: Daily.jsx submit() reads `score` from closure when computing finalScore inside setTimeout callback (`const finalScore = score + (correct ? 1 : 0)`). Works because the closure captures the score before the setScore call took effect; relies on React batching. Safer to compute once at top of submit and use it in both setScore and setDailyResult.

Daily.jsx pct calculation uses `(idx + (running ? 0 : 1)) / TOTAL`; once the final question is answered and running flips false, pct jumps to (lastIdx+1)/30 = 100%, which is fine but the formula is non-obvious. Consider tracking `answered` count explicitly.

game.js generateQuestion has `useMul = op === 'mul' ? true : op === 'div' ? false : r() < 0.5` — when op !== 'mixed', the call-pattern still consumes a different number of rng() calls per branch (mixed consumes one extra r() for useMul decision). This means seeding with op='mixed' produces a different question stream than op='mul'. Acceptable for the daily challenge (always uses 'mixed') but worth noting for reproducibility.

Layout.jsx subscribe() inside useEffect uses inline () => setState(getState()) — fine but creates a new closure each render; no functional issue. Same pattern repeated across pages (Home/Daily/Learn). Could be extracted to a useGameState hook.

Daily.jsx initializes `useState(() => dailyQuestions(TOTAL, 'mixed'))` — questions are computed on first mount and persist for the page lifetime. If a user crosses midnight while on the page, they'll continue with yesterday's seed. Minor edge case, low priority.

Question.jsx hint is only consumed by Learn page; Daily.jsx doesn't pass a hint, so wrong daily answers offer no feedback. That matches the spec (hints in Learn only) but worth confirming with product.
seed_data_creation: Set localStorage state.daily = {date: today, score: 28, total: 30, completed: true} to verify daily-completed gating view; also set opMode=div / opMode=mul to verify Quick-Fire prompt switches between '5 × 7 =' and '20 ÷ 5 =' formats.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is purely client-side (localStorage key tt_arena_state_v2; v1 migration on read). All data-testids from review request are present and reliable. To replay Daily fresh, set state.daily = {date: null, completed: false} and reload /play/daily. Today's seeded first questions are deterministic — useful for assertions. Theme toggle adds/removes 'dark' class on <html>. Sound toggle persists state.soundOn and calls setSoundEnabled in lib/sound.js; sfx.* are Web Audio beeps producing no console errors when fired or when silenced.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Iteration 2 ships cleanly: light/dark theming, brutalist outlines preserved, 1-20 tables, division + mixed ops, Learn page, Daily Challenge, sound toggle, simpler Home — all behave per spec.
